text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"King"—namely, the title of a monarch. It 
refers to the supreme sovereign of a 
single nation or people.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is how a standard dictionary defines 
it. However, in my dictionary— there is 
only one single meaning recorded.
choice_data_list: A king is, in other words—Orfevre

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Audacious and unprecedented. One and 
only...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three years I spent with her... so 
many things happened.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I learned how hard it is to build trusting 
relationships. We also lived through the 
Great Earthquake, whose scars still linger 
across the land...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was a time when I let go of her 
hand. Even so, together with Orfevre, I 
held up the light... and came to reign 
supreme.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—my story with Orfevre will soon enter 
a new chapter.

text_block_list.name: Radio Sound
text_block_list.text:
"—And with that, it is time to say goodbye 
on Late Night Music Salon. Wrapping things 
up, here is the wildly popular youth band, 
'Orfevre'—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The sky had begun to lighten with dawn. 
As if drawn by some inexplicable pull, I 
made my way to the beach... and found 
"her" there.
"...Oh? It's been a while!"

What happened to that goldwork? ...Ah, so 
its purpose has been fulfilled.

Hahaha. Nope, not a thing! I just... feel 
it.

I'm sure that must be... "someone's 
feelings."

It happens. That's just how it is. When 
'that' is strong enough, it takes form... 
and travels.

From somewhere far, far away, across time 
and space itself. To appeal something to 
us...
âLook, once again... I've been drawn in.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...What were you talking to that guy 
about?
choice_data_list: No, it's just a little thing—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I turned around, she was— already 
gone.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"She left long ago. ...That's just the 
kind of person she is."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Speak of love, and it vanishes. Pray for 
it, and it will not appear; forget it, and 
it arrives...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...I do not care for this.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Enough about her. Are the preparations for 
"that" complete?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Very well. Then, let us conquer—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
To that distant land. We shall reclaim the 
crown of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
—Time flies when you're having fun, so 
that means there's only one song left for 
the Special Live!

text_block_list.name: Band Member A
text_block_list.text:
"Once again, to everyone who worked so 
hard to make this happen, and to all the 
locals who welcomed us with open arms... 
Thank you so very much."

text_block_list.name: Band Member A
text_block_list.text:
"I am so happy to play music in this 
place. We've finally... met!"

text_block_list.name: Local Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Mm... yeah, yeah...! I've been waiting for 
youuuuuu!!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
...Shoot, I'm gonna cry! Before I lose my 
voice, here's the last song!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
This is the song dedicated to her that 
gave our band its name! So it reaches that 
girl who's setting off on her journey, we 
will sing—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—It brings back memories of last year. 
Back then, I came to see you off just like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Or hasn't changed. She remains 
magnificent. In fact, she has grown even 
stronger than last year.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: However... what about you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—For some reason, a chill ran down my 
spine. Dream Journey wore her usual calm, 
gentle smile.”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Would you say I've grown compared to back 
then?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Otherwise... there'd be no reason for it 
to be you."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: And what is your basis for that?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "...I see. That is... crucial evidence."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Hey, Trainer. You bastard...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Don't wander off on your own.
choice_data_list: I told you Orfevre was in the way!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I'm not saying it right now.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Same as ever, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "...Elder Sister. Do not worry."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The sun sets. However—I shall shine for 
all eternity.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I know—Orfe.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text: "Lady Orfevre! It is almost time."

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
From Japan, all the way over to where you 
are... I'll be cheering for you with all 
my might...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm—

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fans
text_block_list.text: Orfeeeeevre!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—What the gathered fans unfurled was a 
massive flag... Emblazoned with Orfevre's 
name alongside the Hinomaru.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fans
text_block_list.text:
It's time for revenge! This time—we can 
win! You gave us hope back then... Now 
it's our turn!

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Together with Trainer! Show them the power 
of our King~~!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hear me, my people.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I shall accept your loyalty.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Rejoice in the destiny that had you born 
in my era.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Dreams will crumble. What emerges next—is 
the glory brought by the King.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooohh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Cheeky brat.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't walk ahead of me. —Walk beside 
me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "...Take care, you two."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Have a good journey.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, cane firmly in hand, comfortably 
familiar, the King once again set foot 
upon that land.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Now then.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I am thoroughly satisfied. Nothing is 
lacking."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
There is nothing beyond my grasp. 
Everything is—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
O staff. Guide me toward inevitable 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"—Until all of creation prostrates itself 
before Orfevre."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How it ended for them— will surely be 
passed down by those who love the great 
king.
